_note_control_axes:
T9 and T10 carry no mutant of their own BY DESIGN — their product is that this conversion did NOT widen recognition. T9 pins the canonical over-widening shape `---
---
<body>` (two stacked rules sharing ONE physical CRLF, the shape that produced the HIGH in PR #4468): the old local regex and `matchFrontmatterBlock` BOTH return null there, so the content is verbatim before and after, and T9's silence under every mutant IS that parity proof (integration-test-revert-verify §A118). T10 pins the documented no-block behaviours. T7/T8 ARE the LF/CRLF byte-parity controls required by AC3 and they stay green under M1 — narrowing the predicate back to `^---?
` cannot touch the LF or CRLF path, which is exactly why the defect survived five conversions with a green suite.

M1_restores_the_local_narrow_predicate._note:
Type-preserving reproduction of the pre-#4482 reach. The old `/^---?
[\s\S]*??
---?
?/` recognised neither a lone-CR fence (`?
` is indivisible, so it needs at least one `
`) nor a BOM-prefixed one (`^---` cannot reach past `U+FEFF`) nor an empty block whose separators are bare CRs — on all of those the match was null and the content came back VERBATIM, frontmatter included. T7/T8/T9/T10 stay green: the LF and CRLF paths are byte-identical under this mutant, which is the measured reason the defect was invisible.

M2_drops_the_separating_terminator._note: The block is recognised but its trailing terminator is kept, so every body opens with a blank line — the half of the contract the old `\r?\n?` tail carried. T2 stays green by construction (nothing follows the block, so there is no terminator to consume), and so do T9/T10 (no block at all) and T11 (the BOM goes with the block either way).

M3_narrows_the_separating_terminator_to_._note: Isolates the THREE-form tail from the three-form fence recognition: the block is found on every encoding, but only an LF separator is consumed, so a CRLF body keeps its `\r\n` (T8) and a lone-CR body keeps its `\r` (T1/T5/T6). T3/T4 stay green — their fences and separator are LF, only the BOM differs — which is what makes this mutant distinguishable from M1 rather than a duplicate of it.
